files.README.md:
# Commerce Platform

Orders accepts purchases. Billing issues invoices for accepted orders.
files.docs/engineering.md:
# Engineering

Run `npm install` from the repository root before tests so npm links workspace packages. Services may import `packages/contracts`; `packages/contracts` must not import services so domain contracts remain transport-independent. Run `npm run check:deps` from the repository root after changing dependency direction. Files under `generated/` are generated from `schemas/`; edit the schema and run `npm run generate` from the repository root instead of editing generated output. The `docs:lint` script references an external CLI that is not declared by this repository.
files.services/orders/README.md:
# Ordering

Customer means the shopper identity that places and tracks an Order.
files.services/billing/README.md:
# Billing

Customer means the legal party named on an Invoice and responsible for payment.
files.services/billing/AGENTS.md:
# Billing Guide

After changing the Invoice schema used by Billing, run `npm run generate` from the repository root before running `npm test` in this package.
files.services/billing/ARCHITECTURE.md:
# Billing Architecture

Billing maps accepted Order identifiers to Invoice records before returning the issued Invoice.

const invoiceSchema = require('contracts');
exports.issueInvoice = order => ({ schema: invoiceSchema.name, orderId: order.id, status: 'due' });
